intro: ORIF makes your programme machine-readable. The path is deliberately pragmatic: implement once, pass data on automatically, then use new services and networking opportunities.

steps.title: Implement
steps.body: Give your web agency or in-house IT team the link to the technical ORIF documentation. Depending on the site setup, the JSON interface can be integrated in a few development hours.

steps.title: Automate
steps.body: Once the interface is built, its link can be shared with event platforms, archives or other partners. Programme data is then transferred automatically instead of being copied manually.

steps.title: Transform
steps.body: With ORIF, you become part of a growing community committed to digital networking and open data exchange. You help shape which theatre data becomes available and in what form.

quote.body: Historical and current programme data could be retrieved automatically through the interface. The Cultural Data Space catalogue service, standard templates for data-use agreements and professional exchange within the community would also be especially valuable for us.
quote.source: Dr. Melanie Gruss, Tanzarchiv Leipzig e.V. / NFDI4Culture
